productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: iHerb product URL to scrape reviews from.

productId.title: Product ID (Optional)
productId.description: Numeric iHerb product ID. If empty, it is extracted from productUrl.

maxReviews.title: Maximum Reviews
maxReviews.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape (0 = unlimited).

sortBy.title: Sort Reviews By
sortBy.description: Review sort order. Ignored when a numeric `sortId` is provided.

sortId.title: Sort ID (Numeric Override)
sortId.description: Numeric sort ID override used by the iHerb review API. Takes priority over `sortBy`. Leave empty to use `sortBy`. Known values: 1 = highest rating, 2 = lowest rating, 4 = most helpful, 6 = most recent, 7 = oldest.

languageCode.title: Language Code
languageCode.description: Optional IETF language tag to filter reviews by language (e.g. ru-RU). Leave empty to keep the source review language and return reviews in all languages.

countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description: Optional ISO country code to filter reviews by reviewer country (e.g. US, PK). Leave empty for all countries.

isShowTranslated.title: Show Translated Review Text
isShowTranslated.description: When enabled, request translated review text. Disabled by default so unfiltered runs do not force reviews into English.

withImagesOnly.title: Only Reviews With Images
withImagesOnly.description: When enabled, only collect reviews that include customer images.

withCountryReview.title: Include Country Reviews
withCountryReview.description: When enabled, request country-level review breakdown metadata from the API.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for reliable scraping on protected pages. Residential proxy is enabled by default for smoother runs.
